components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #5ce1c9; color: #0b0f0e; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #48ceb7; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(92, 225, 201, 0.3); transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Dark slate container button with slate stroke.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #1b2523; color: #f2f4f1; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(91, 102, 99, 0.45); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #24322f; color: #5ce1c9; border-color: rgba(92, 225, 201, 0.5); }

components.name: Diagnostic Card
components.description: Deep charcoal surface card with metric readout.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #111716; color: #f2f4f1; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(91, 102, 99, 0.45); border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 14px; color: #5b6663; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-metric { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; color: #5ce1c9; }

narrative.overview: ThinkClock Battery Labs captures the precision and aesthetic depth of advanced electrochemical physics, signal spectroscopy, and hardware-software battery intelligence.
keyCharacteristics: Deep obsidian dark mode with glowing radial gradients.
High-contrast typography pairing geometric display with readable sans and data mono.
Tonal layering over heavy dropshadows; translucent glass surfaces with slate borders.
Signal-driven micro-interactions and interactive canvas visualizations.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: The Mint Signal Teal accent (#5ce1c9) represents ≤10% of any screen layout.

rules.name: The Monospace Measurement Rule
rules.body: Any numerical value representing battery metrics MUST be rendered in IBM Plex Mono.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat with subtle border strokes; glow shadows appear strictly during state transitions.

dos: Do use #5ce1c9 (Mint Signal Teal) for actionable buttons and diagnostic focus states.
Do format technical metrics, numbers, and battery specs in IBM Plex Mono.
Do maintain crisp 1px graphite borders (rgba(91, 102, 99, 0.45)) on dark card surfaces.
donts: Don't use bright non-brand accent colors.
Don't clutter cards with heavy multi-layer box shadows.
Don't use low-contrast text for critical battery diagnostic readouts.
